request.query:
mutation CreateService($name: String!, $ownerId: String, $environmentId: String, $type: String, $repo: String, $image: String, $registryCredentialId: String, $branch: String, $rootDir: String, $runtime: String, $buildCommand: String, $startCommand: String, $dockerfilePath: String, $buildFilter: BuildFilterInput, $plan: String, $autoDeploy: Boolean, $schedule: String, $command: String, $publishPath: String, $port: Int, $envVars: [EnvVarInput], $secretFiles: [SecretFileInput]) {
  createService(
    name: $name
    ownerId: $ownerId
    environmentId: $environmentId
    type: $type
    repo: $repo
    image: $image
    registryCredentialId: $registryCredentialId
    branch: $branch
    rootDir: $rootDir
    runtime: $runtime
    buildCommand: $buildCommand
    startCommand: $startCommand
    dockerfilePath: $dockerfilePath
    buildFilter: $buildFilter
    plan: $plan
    autoDeploy: $autoDeploy
    schedule: $schedule
    command: $command
    publishPath: $publishPath
    port: $port
    envVars: $envVars
    secretFiles: $secretFiles
  ) {
    id
    name
    type
    phase
    projectId
    environmentId
    registryCredentialId
    latestDeployId
    __typename
  }
}

request.query:
query ServiceEvents($serviceId: String!, $startTime: String!, $endTime: String!, $cursor: String, $limit: Int) {
  serviceEvents(
    serviceId: $serviceId
    startTime: $startTime
    endTime: $endTime
    cursor: $cursor
    limit: $limit
  ) {
    id
    type
    timestamp
    cursor
    details {
      deployId
      deployStatus
      preDeployStatus
      fullDeployStatus
      failureReason
      cancelReason
      stallReason
      status
      actor
      triggeredByUser
      image
      commitId
      commitMessage
      startedAt
      finishedAt
      reasonCode
      exitCode
      instanceId
      fromCount
      toCount
      branchFrom
      branchTo
      commitUrl
      projectFrom
      projectTo
      environmentFrom
      environmentTo
      trigger {
        firstBuild
        envUpdated
        manual
        deployedByRender
        clearCache
        rollback
        deployHook
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
